summary: Lower an anonymous class expression to a generated C# type when its value is used only through statically known construction/member operations.

target.notes: Generate a uniquely named C# type and rewrite uses of the local class binding to that generated type. Do not materialize a System.Type as a substitute for the JavaScript class object.

caveats: Local class expressions may capture lexical variables; such captures need closure-aware lowering.
JavaScript class identity is a runtime object when it escapes.

tests.name: anonymous expression used only with new
tests.input: const C = class { m() { return 1; } }; console.log(new C().m());
tests.expected_csharp: private sealed class __J2csClass0 { public double m() => 1d; }

tests.name: edge: identity escapes
tests.input: function consume(x){ console.log(typeof x); } const C = class {}; consume(C);
tests.expected_behavior: prints function; this rule must not match because the JavaScript constructor object escapes
